Maria: Quick Q on the rate-limit contract — we need a clear decision on the 429 headers we return and how burst behavior is documented. Do we require Retry-After + X-RateLimit-*? Also how do we describe per-route vs global quotas?
Kevin: I think minimal requirement should be `Retry-After`. Additional `X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset` are nice-to-have but helpful for SDKs.
Laura: +1. For per-route limits we should emit `X-RateLimit-Scope: route` (or `global`) so clients know which quota hit them.
Sam: For burst semantics, our runtime uses token-bucket-ish shaping. Suggest we document: short bursts allowed up to 1.5x sustained rate for <=5s, then throttle down to steady window.
Maria: Good. Can we standardize the header names and value formats? e.g., `Retry-After` (seconds), `X-RateLimit-Limit` (int), `X-RateLimit-Remaining` (int), `X-RateLimit-Reset` (unix epoch seconds), `X-RateLimit-Scope` (route|global)
Kevin: Sounds right. Also include a JSON body payload for 429 with machine-readable code so SDKs can switch behavior without parsing text: `{\n  "error": "quota_exhausted",\n  "scope": "route",\n  "retry_after": 10\n}` (we'll include as example)
Laura: Quick note on backward compatibility — older clients expect just a 429 and a human message. We should make headers additive: always include `Retry-After`, but make `X-RateLimit-*` optional for older regions while we roll out. Document that pre-v2 SDKs may ignore new headers.
CI-Bot: test-rate-limit-headers failed in PR #412: expected `X-RateLimit-Remaining` header when returning 429 for /v1/generate, got none.
Maria: Thanks CI-Bot — that's the failing test I mentioned. Action items: update OpenAPI spec to require `Retry-After` for 429, recommend `X-RateLimit-*` and `X-RateLimit-Scope`, add example body with `error: quota_exhausted`. Kevin + Laura to add unit + e2e tests.
Kevin: I'll take the OpenAPI + unit tests.
Laura: I'll add e2e (routing + per-route hit) and update the runtime doc for burst policy.
Sam: I’ll add a short paragraph in the runtime README explaining the 1.5x/5s burst rule and fallback behavior (no automatic fallback to other routes; clients should explicitly retry or route to a cheaper model).
Maria: One more: should we set `X-RateLimit-Reset` to epoch seconds OR a delta? Kevin, which is easier for SDKs?
Kevin: epoch seconds is easier for caching and avoids clock-drift edge cases if we also return `Retry-After`. We'll do epoch seconds.
Laura: Sounds good. I'll stub the spec change and link to it here when ready.
Maria: Great — target to merge spec + tests by end of sprint. Thanks! :+1: 
Kevin: ack :+1:
Laura: ack :+1:
CI-Bot: Retrying CI after fixes...
